items.title: Little evidence from small hospitals
items.whyItMatters: Only a few small hospitals appear in the measured evidence, and none in the experience evidence retrieved so far.
items.opportunity: Search provincial and French-language reports for small-hospital programmes.

items.title: Incompatible measures and denominators
items.whyItMatters: Days of therapy and defined daily doses with different denominators cannot be compared (claim c6).
items.opportunity: Chart each measure and denominator in strand A rather than extracting a single number.

items.title: Nurses are missing from most experience studies
items.whyItMatters: Nurses carry recommendations but are invisible in reports (claim c7).
items.opportunity: Chart the professional groups in each strand B study and search for nurse-focused reports.

items.title: Staffing cost of in-person delivery
items.whyItMatters: Handshake rounds raise acceptance but cost pharmacist hours (claims c2, c5).
items.opportunity: Chart staffing and time wherever reported.

items.title: Clinical outcomes confounded by concurrent policies
items.whyItMatters: C. difficile falls coincided with restriction policies.
items.opportunity: Chart concurrent interventions next to every clinical outcome.

errorsFound: The first appraisal reply annotated a cluster trial that was never retrieved; that annotation was refused and must not appear in the map or the committee summary.
reevaluation: The gaps confirm two separately charted strands, with small hospitals, nurses and staffing given explicit charting items.
summary: Five gaps: small hospitals, incompatible measures, nurses, staffing and confounded clinical outcomes.
